packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates ride together — one PR a week rather than thirty.

description: Tauri's Rust crates and JS packages are versioned together and must move
together. A tauri-plugin bumped without its @tauri-apps/plugin-* twin fails
at runtime with a missing-command error rather than at build time.
Never let Renovate move these on its own. `react`/`react-dom` majors and
`tailwindcss` majors have both broken this codebase's idioms before — v4
replaced the entire config format — so they get a PR to read, not a merge.
